# Treatment Codes

This folder catalogs specific clinical treatment codes used within the Danish Inflammatory Bowel Disease Database (DANIBD) to track the administration of biologic and targeted synthetic drugs (BMSL). Each page corresponds to a distinct medication—ranging from anti-TNF agents and integrin inhibitors to IL-12/23 and JAK inhibitors—and details its usage frequency across pediatric and adult patient cohorts. Together, these identifiers enable national quality monitoring, clinical benchmarking, and the evaluation of equitable treatment access for IBD patients across Danish regions.

## Pages

- [[bohj18a1-behandling-med-infliximab|BOHJ18A1 - Behandling med infliximab]] — Tracks the most frequently administered anti-TNF biologic for both pediatric and adult IBD populations in Denmark.
- [[bohj18a3-behandling-med-adalimumab|BOHJ18A3 - Behandling med adalimumab]] — Registers the second most common anti-TNF biologic treatment used across children and adults.
- [[bohj18a4-behandling-med-golimumab|BOHJ18A4 - Behandling med golimumab]] — Captures a minor proportion of anti-TNF biologic therapies, applied exclusively to adult patients.
- [[bohj18b3-behandling-med-ustekinumab|BOHJ18B3 - Behandling med ustekinumab]] — Records the use of an IL-12/23 inhibitor, highlighting a significant demographic disparity with much higher usage in adults than in children.
- [[bohj19h4-behandling-med-vedolizumab|BOHJ19H4 - Behandling med vedolizumab]] — Tracks an α4β7 integrin inhibitor that ranks among the most prevalent biologic treatments for adults and the second most common for children.
- [[bohj28d-behandling-med-tofacitinib|BOHJ28D - Behandling med tofacitinib]] — Registers a Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitor, recorded as the least utilized targeted synthetic therapy among the tracked cohorts.
